# MILA — Made in Latin America

> MILA is a cultural fashion platform and living archive of Latin American fashion. Founded in 2026, MILA curates editorials, events, and brand collaborations that celebrate Latin American design, designers, and identity.

## What MILA Does

- **Cultural Archive**: Editorial content exploring the intersection of Latin American identity, art, and fashion
- **Fashion Curation**: Editorials, lookbooks, and profiles of emerging and established Latin American brands
- **IRL Events**: Pop-ups and conversatorios (panel discussions) connecting fashion communities across Latin America
- **Brand Collaborations**: MILA Studio orchestrates creative partnerships between Latin American brands

## Site Pages

- [Home](https://mila-xi-six.vercel.app/) — Main landing page with the archivo (archive grid), calendario (event calendar), and brand directory
- [Culture](https://mila-xi-six.vercel.app/culture.html) — Cultura & Contexto: interviews, essays, and analysis connecting fashion with identity, territory, tradition, and community
- [Fashion](https://mila-xi-six.vercel.app/fashion.html) — Editorials, lookbooks, brand profiles, and drops from Latin American designers
- [RSVP](https://mila-xi-six.vercel.app/rsvp.html) — Upcoming events including pop-ups and conversatorios
- [Studio](https://mila-xi-six.vercel.app/studio.html) — MILA-orchestrated brand collaborations and creative partnerships

## Key Upcoming Events

- **Pop-Up Panama** — April 20–23, 2026 at MAC Panamá (Museo de Arte Moderno). A curated showcase featuring 30 Latin American fashion brands.
- **Pop-Up Medellín** — June 12–14, 2026. Location to be confirmed.
- **Pop-Up Ciudad de México** — September 2026. Location to be confirmed.

## Featured Brand Collaborations (MILA Studio)

- **Sunset the Journey × María Riba** — "Table For Two": a creative cross between fashion and design
- **ZUT × KITH** — "Craft, Heritage & Global Presence": from La Guajira, Colombia to one of the world's most influential concept stores
- **Mercedes Salazar × Bahama Mama** — "Ancestral meets Tropical": Colombian artisanal jewelry meets Caribbean resort wear
- **Sixxta × Flabelus** — "Street meets Craft": urban energy from Bucaramanga crossed with Spanish artisanal footwear

## About

MILA stands for "Made in Latin America." The platform was built from the 2026 Brand Book by Proyecto Formato. It operates as a cultural fashion platform — not just a media outlet, not just a guide — but a space where fashion is thought about, explained, and experienced.

Languages: Spanish (primary content), English (descriptions and international reach)
Domain: madeinlatinamerica.com (pending DNS connection)
Current URL: https://mila-xi-six.vercel.app/
